ValidationRule.description: This validation rule is created as part of STY-02249.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.CaseValidations__c ) , NOT( $Permission.NSP_FLSA ) , NOT( CONTAINS( $User.NSP_Profile_Name__c , 'System Admin' ) ) , CONTAINS( $Label.NSP_FLSA_Case_Sub_Categories , NSP_SubCategory__c ) , NSP_Category__c = 'HR Admin Compliance - FLSA' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only the FLSA Group can create this type of case. If your client needs this service, please contact the FLSA Group.
